verdict.rationale: Tailscale's persistent mesh network and Tailscale SSH feature let users reach devices by name without re-authenticating each session, as shown by user testimonials of SSH'ing into boxes immediately after install ('just SSH'ed into my boxes...like I'm home'). However, there's no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'saved host' list or one-tap UI element as a discrete terminal feature—this is inferred from general always-on connectivity rather than a documented saved-host quick-connect capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a saved-hosts/quick-connect UI, first-party mention of 'one-tap' terminal access, and independent hands-on confirmation of credential-free reconnection specifically for SSH sessions.
